title: Companies Act, 2013 — private-company meeting exemptions under section 462

content.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
content.citation: Notification G.S.R. 464(E), 5 June 2015, read with G.S.R. 583(E), 13 June 2017, and corrigendum S.O. 2218(E), 13 July 2017
content.verificationStatus: Gazette PDF copies of G.S.R. 464(E) (5 June 2015) and G.S.R. 583(E) (13 June 2017) retrieved and operative clauses checked through IndiaCode-hosted Gazette PDFs; direct MCA-hosted copies and corrigendum S.O. 2218(E) (13 July 2017) not independently retrieved.
content.note: Primary-instrument scope check: the Gazette PDF copy of G.S.R. 464(E), 5 June 2015, was retrieved through IndiaCode and its Chapter VII row lists sections 101–107 and section 109, applying unless otherwise specified in the respective section or the company’s articles provide otherwise. The Gazette PDF copy of G.S.R. 583(E), 13 June 2017, was also retrieved through IndiaCode; paragraph 7 inserts paragraph 2A limiting the table’s exceptions, modifications and adaptations to private companies that have not defaulted in filing financial statements under section 137 or annual returns under section 92. The direct MCA-hosted PDFs and corrigendum S.O. 2218(E), 13 July 2017, were not independently retrieved; secondary reproduction/provenance remains the basis for the corrigendum. Verify the corrigendum, subsequent/current notification position, company filing eligibility and articles before applying any modification. This scoped source review is not final legal sign-off.
